title: Removal Scope in a Mold Protocol Supplement — Insurance Claim Services Desk Note
content:
The removal priced in an Insurance Claim Services protocol supplement depends on where the growth recorded on the Mold Remediation job awaiting clearance is located.

**Rule.** The removal is priced as follows: for growth in an attic or crawlspace, insulation removal over the growth area plus one debris disposal load at the tier's fee, because an attic carries no drywall to remove and the insulation leaves the building as bagged debris; for growth in a basement, drywall removal over the growth area only, because basement walls are uninsulated foundation walls; for growth anywhere else, drywall removal and insulation removal over the growth area at the tier's rates per square foot.

## Points of judgement

- Attic or crawlspace: growth area multiplied by the tier's insulation removal rate, plus one load at the tier's debris disposal fee per load. No drywall removal.
- Basement: growth area multiplied by the tier's drywall removal rate. No insulation removal.
- Living area or HVAC system: growth area multiplied by the sum of the tier's drywall removal and insulation removal rates.

*Hypothetical:* 180 square feet in a crawlspace, insulation removal 0.95 per square foot, debris disposal 165.00 a load: 171.00 plus 165.00, or 336.00. The same area in a basement at a drywall removal rate of 1.30: 234.00.
